capabilities: List all checkboxes of the active note in a sidebar panel, nested as in the note
Toggle a checkbox from the panel through the editor
Jump the cursor to a task's line by clicking it
Group tasks under headings with per-section and total done/total counts
Filter completed tasks in or out of view
disambiguation: Not a global task manager; it only lists checkboxes from the currently open note, not tasks across the whole vault.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer; tasks come from Obsidian's metadata cache, so the panel refreshes shortly after saves. Includes BRAT instructions for pre-release installs.
problem: Obsidian shows checkboxes only inside the note text, so there is no side panel for viewing, toggling, and navigating a note's tasks at a glance.

relations.evidence: BRAT installs plugins straight from a GitHub release and keeps them updated

summary: Sidebar panel that lists every checkbox in the active note, grouped by heading, with click-to-toggle, line jumps and completion counts.
